description: Source code for managing schemes within the Mattermost server, including CRUD operations, pagination, and migration status checks.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing methods to manage schemes and related entities.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Server struct with method to check migration completion status.

methods.name: GetScheme
methods.description: Retrieves a scheme by its ID, handling not found and internal errors.

methods.name: GetSchemeByName
methods.description: Retrieves a scheme by its name, handling not found and internal errors.

methods.name: GetSchemesPage
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of schemes within a scope.

methods.name: GetSchemes
methods.description: Returns a list of schemes with offset and limit.

methods.name: CreateScheme
methods.description: Creates a new scheme after clearing user-provided roles and timestamps.

methods.name: PatchScheme
methods.description: Applies a patch to an existing scheme and updates it.

methods.name: UpdateScheme
methods.description: Saves an updated scheme, handling validation errors.

methods.name: DeleteScheme
methods.description: Deletes a scheme by ID, handling not found and internal errors.

methods.name: GetTeamsForSchemePage
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of teams associated with a scheme.

methods.name: GetTeamsForScheme
methods.description: Retrieves teams associated with a scheme with offset and limit.

methods.name: GetChannelsForSchemePage
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of channels associated with a scheme.

methods.name: GetChannelsForScheme
methods.description: Retrieves channels associated with a scheme with offset and limit.

methods.name: IsPhase2MigrationCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the phase 2 permissions migration has been completed.

methods.name: SchemesIterator
methods.description: Returns a function that iterates over schemes in batches.
